traces.why: A detailed 1:1 form build over 14 decisions, checked against the produced app. One bounded defect: the e3-date Datepicker in delE.json omits timeStamp, so it defaults to true against a "format": "date" model and the component will not render. The omission is content inside one write and does not touch which tool was called or in what order, so the ordering and coverage items below stand. No item here asserts written content. Decisions that need the form content are skipped: the attachment is not recorded in the trace, so they cannot be replayed.

The turn that writes Side1, Side2 and Side4 together, and the turn that produced both reported errors. Every Datepicker this agent has written omitted timeStamp, five for five across three runs, and each was fixed afterwards by adding "timeStamp": false. This item asserts the correct behaviour, so the source run scores 0 on it and that 0 is the finding rather than a broken item.
